title: Craft tiered launch summaries and two-stage review
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a repeatable process and templates for tiered launch summaries (internal exec brief, technical impact note for Support/Eng, and concise customer-facing update) and implement a two-stage review flow: (1) technical validation by Eng/Research, (2) communications signoff by PMM/Legal. Purpose is to reduce review cycles, ensure consistent wording across channels, and support localization and embargoed releases.
acceptance_criteria: Three ready-to-use summary templates (Executive, Technical, Customer) with fill-in fields
A documented two-stage review checklist and explicit signoff owners for each template
Localization checklist and recommended turnaround times added to template notes
A sample staged schedule for a typical small/medium feature release with ownership assigned
One dry-run completed with cross-functional reviewers and feedback captured
updates: 2026-03-02: Ticket created after weekly GTM sync; observed repeated rework across teams for recent feature launches.
2026-03-03: Draft templates uploaded to Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch-ops/templates/tiered-summaries-v0 (working doc)
2026-03-04: Met with Eng leads (R. Gomez) and Support (M. Park) to validate technical template fields; added platform impact checklist.
2026-03-05: PMM (S. Rivera) suggested explicit embargo language and a 'customer consequences' blurb — incorporated into customer template.
2026-03-06: Requested two engineers for dry-run; assigned reviewers list and proposed dry-run date 2026-03-12. Noted dependency on release notes ownership in PM-11023.
proposed_communication_channels: Internal Slack #launch-ops and weekly GTM digest
Support knowledge base article and playbook
draft_summary_snippets: Executive (one-paragraph): 'This release introduces X optimization to the serving runtime that reduces tail latency for long-context workloads by ~18% for P99 cases. Impact: lower latency SLO violations for customers using streaming responses.'

Technical (bullet list): 'What changed: kernel selection heuristic, updated batching policy, fallback path for quantized models. Migration notes: no customer action required; recommended config if using Dedicated: enable auto-batching.'
Customer (concise): 'We've improved response times for longer chats and streaming — no action required. If you rely on Dedicated capacity, consider the suggested autoscaling tweak to fully benefit.'
